## Description

Upload PDF/images (desk scanner, phone camera, file) with type and source; stored in private Blob (CMK) with random keys; Defender for Storage / malware scan before availability; viewer streams via user-delegation SAS valid ≤ 5 minutes, watermarked with viewer and time; no download for reception; original file always kept; failed upload → retry.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A file is not viewable until the malware scan passes; infected files are quarantined and the uploader is told.
- [ ] **AC2.** Viewer links expire within 5 minutes and are bound to the requesting user; blob names contain no PHI.
- [ ] **AC3.** Receptionists can upload and see the document list but cannot open clinical documents (policy test).
- [ ] **AC4.** Original files are immutable; metadata edits (type, date) are audited.
- [ ] **AC5.** Phone camera capture works on mobile web (multi-page to single PDF).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
